name: com.citoyenapp/citoyen
title: Citoyen
description: Official statistics for 19 countries and the EU: series, comparisons, rankings, release dates.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Find the official statistic behind a question on a country's economy or society (unemployment, inflation, growth, deficit, debt, wages, housing, crime, immigration, energy…) for 19 countries and the EU, plus related briefings and reform factsheets. Accepts keywords or a whole question, e.g. "youth unemployment Italy", "dette publique France", "why did the French deficit widen". Returns indicator codes and the countries that have a card for each.

query.description: Words to search, in any of English, French or Spanish.

country.description: Optional ISO 3166 alpha-2 country code (FR, US…) or EU.

language.description: Language of names and period labels (default en).

tools.name: get_series
tools.description: Latest official value, change over a year and history of one indicator for one country, as charted on its Citoyen card: answers « what is the current rate », « how has it moved over the last months / quarters / years ». Values by period (newest first), unit, official producer, link to verify at the source, Citoyen page and CSV. Last 10 years by default.

country.description: ISO 3166 alpha-2 country code (FR, US, DE…), EU or WLD.

years.description: Years of history before the latest point (default 10, max 80).

language.description: Language of names and period labels (default en).

tools.name: compare_countries
tools.description: Compares one indicator across 2 to 8 countries (e.g. « unemployment in France vs Germany », « debt of Italy, Spain and Greece ») from ONE harmonised source (Eurostat, OECD, IMF, ILO, BIS or World Bank), so values are comparable. Countries the source does not cover are listed apart. Last 10 years by default.

language.description: Language of names and period labels (default en).

tools.name: get_ranking
tools.description: Ranks every covered country on one indicator (« which country has the highest inflation », « where does France stand on debt ») for the latest period most countries share (one harmonised source). Neutral order: highest value first, not best or worst. Not every indicator is rankable (indexes, counts, amounts in local currency are not).

language.description: Language of names and period labels (default en).

tools.name: get_publication
tools.description: Key points of a Citoyen publication: a synthesis note, an analysis or a reform factsheet, given its URL or path as returned by `search` (e.g. /reforms/fr/pension-reform-2023, /analyses/france-deficit, /syntheses/FR/economy). Returns the title, summary, date and up to 6 key points with the link to the full text, never the full text.

url.description: Citoyen URL or path of the publication.

language.description: Language of names and period labels (default en).

tools.name: get_release_calendar
tools.description: Next publications of the series Citoyen charts: official dates from the producer's calendar (Eurostat, ONS, Insee, Statistics Canada) or estimated windows from past release lags. Filter by country, indicator or theme. Next 30 days by default.

country.description: Optional ISO 3166 alpha-2 country code (FR, US…), EU or WLD.

theme.description: Optional theme code (economy, labor, prices, housing…).

days.description: Horizon in days from today (default 30, max 90).

officialOnly.description: Only dates announced by the producer (default false).

language.description: Language of names and period labels (default en).
